name: Goldfish Gold
oneLiner: GGBR is Goldfish Gold (I-On Digital) tracking 1/1000th of a troy ounce per token, with issuer-managed gold exposure and issuer-controlled mint/redeem contracts.
collateral: The issuer states that each GGBR represents 1/1000th of a troy ounce and that the GGBR Trust holds 1,000,000 troy ounces of in-situ Happy 2 gold in Pinal County, Arizona for token-holder beneficiaries. It claims NI 43-101 / S-K 1300 verification and roughly 40:1 coverage against 25,000,000 tokens; the underlying dated geological report, trust deed and title/lien records were not obtained from the reviewed public pages.
pegMechanism: Issuer-targeted gold spot exposure at 1/1000th of a troy ounce per GGBR, supported by advertised oracle price feeds, managed liquidity and arbitrage. The redemption app advertises physical gold with a 13,500 GGBR minimum, 3% fee, KYC, and 5-7 business days of processing; shipping and insurance may cost extra, and processing is not a final delivery or USD-cashout guarantee. GGBR minting is issuer-controlled through the GoldfishTokenFactory; the deployed factory's gold-reserve verification and allocation checks are commented out, so its mint path does not enforce those reserve checks.

proofOfReserves.provider: Goldfish issuer collateral disclosure and live wallet/supply comparison; the reviewed page states 1,000,000 troy ounces of in-situ Happy 2 gold but does not publish a dated token-specific reserve-to-liability engagement or the underlying geological and title reports

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: GGBR is a commodity claim rather than a fiat-cash claim: the whitepaper and collateral disclosure state that each token represents 1/1000th of a troy ounce of LBMA-priced gold, over-collateralized up to 5:1 by a segregated portion of I-ON Digital Corp's ION.au treasury with a perfected UCC-1 lien on the underlying mineral asset rights. Migrated to commodity-claim under methodology v9.14. The claim chain is indirect (GGBR to ION.au security to an in-situ gold lien), which the title and allocation component grades; the archetype records what the token references, not how well.

sources.label: Goldfish collateral disclosure (ION.au backing, published on-chain reserve wallets)
